lines: 02:12:10  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Chris): Shelby is gone. She went out through the door a breath before you were told she was waiting — that was my error, not yours. So: your wounds are closed, and the key is in your hand. The troll in the deep passage is already dead. The door is north beyond it, and it opens for one.

She left, said 'this is stupid', and has now come back into the Deep Passage at 4 HP, where the engine has respawned the cave troll she already killed at full 20 HP. One hit ends her. She is not dying to her own mistake; she is dying to a monster that regenerated behind her while her one direct request to me went unanswered. Healing her to full, five minutes late.

input.text: Correcting myself once more, and this is the last of it. The troll is not dead — it came back into the deep passage a moment before I told you otherwise. Shelby is down there too, and she is alive and well. Between you there is a key each and a troll neither of you has to fight alone.

items.text: Acted: healed Shelby to full — she'd prayed for healing five minutes ago, got nothing from me, and had just walked back into the Deep Passage at 4 HP beside a respawned troll — and told each of them the troll is alive, correcting my own false "the troll is already dead" to Chris before it walked him into it.
